name: chat-cartridge
purpose: Take your chat with you. One SKILL.md any AI can read: 'wrap up' writes the chat as one plain file you own (the Brainstem chat export shape, with three next jobs after |||NEXT|||), and 'carry on' starts from that file in any other AI. An AI that carries on writes only its new turns; a small tool joins the files so nothing said earlier can change. STAGING: one relay across three vendors on one machine; it moves down a layer only after real users on more than one install (proven-winner rule).

SKILL.md.purpose: The one page. Hand its address to any AI.

cartridge.py.purpose: Optional checker and joiner: check, next, join, grew, from-claude. Python 3, standard library only.

README.md.purpose: What it is, the two lines you say, and what has been seen so far.
